grammar.purpose: Signal uncertainty and an unwelcome possibility
grammar.explanation: 大概六点到 is an estimate, not a guarantee. 恐怕要下雨 often presents an unwelcome possibility politely; it is not simply the verb 害怕. Neither adverb proves the event occurred. 大约 estimates an amount or time; avoid silently upgrading any estimate to a confirmed appointment.

examples.py: tā dà gài liù diǎn dào .
examples.en: She will probably arrive at six.
I am afraid it may rain.

examples.py: dà gài huì lái , dàn hái méi què rèn .
examples.en: She will probably come, but it is not confirmed.

commonMistakes.wrong: 大概六点到，就是保证六点到。
commonMistakes.why: An estimate does not guarantee an exact time.

grammar.explanation: 要是下雨，就在室内见 states what to do under a condition, without asserting that the condition will occur. 就 belongs with the resulting plan. Use 如果 similarly, and distinguish a hypothetical consequence from a report of an event that has already happened.

examples.py: yào shì xià yǔ , jiù zài shì nèi jiàn .

examples.zh: 要是她还没到，我们就先发消息。
examples.py: yào shì tā hái méi dào , wǒ men jiù xiān fā xiāo xī .
examples.en: If she has not arrived, we will message first.

examples.zh: 要是地点关了，就换一个。
examples.py: yào shì dì diǎn guān le , jiù huàn yī gè .
examples.en: If the venue is closed, change it.

commonMistakes.wrong: 要是下雨，所以已经取消了。
commonMistakes.right: 要是下雨，就改在室内见。
commonMistakes.why: Keep the conditional plan separate from a completed cancellation.

lines.zh: 周六去河边的事，还去吗？
lines.py: zhōu liù qù hé biān de shì , hái qù ma ?
lines.en: Are we still going to the river on Saturday?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 想去。不过天气预报说下午有雨。
lines.py: xiǎng qù . bù guò tiān qì yù bào shuō xià wǔ yǒu yǔ .
lines.en: I'd like to, but the forecast says rain in the afternoon.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那我们早上去？大概九点出门。
lines.py: nà wǒ men zǎo shàng qù ? dà gài jiǔ diǎn chū mén .
lines.en: Shall we go in the morning? Leave around nine.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 恐怕不行，我上午要上课。
lines.py: kǒng pà bù xíng , wǒ shàng wǔ yào shàng kè .
lines.en: I'm afraid I can't. I have class in the morning.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那下午在我家见吧，要是没下雨，再出去。
lines.py: nà xià wǔ zài wǒ jiā jiàn ba , yào shì méi xià yǔ , zài chū qù .
lines.en: Come to mine in the afternoon, then. If it doesn't rain, we can go out.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，几点到？
lines.py: hǎo , jǐ diǎn dào ?
lines.en: Okay. What time should I arrive?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 两点左右。你不用带吃的，我来做。
lines.py: liǎng diǎn zuǒ yòu . nǐ bù yòng dài chī de , wǒ lái zuò .
lines.en: Around two. No need to bring food; I'll cook.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我带点茶吧，家里还有一盒。
lines.py: wǒ dài diǎn chá ba , jiā lǐ hái yǒu yī hé .
lines.en: I'll bring some tea. I have a box at home.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 行。路上大约要多久？
lines.py: xíng . lù shàng dà yuē yào duō jiǔ ?
lines.en: Sure. How long does the journey take?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 二十分钟左右，下课以后我先回家拿茶。
lines.py: èr shí fēn zhōng zuǒ yòu , xià kè yǐ hòu wǒ xiān huí jiā ná chá .
lines.en: About twenty minutes. I'll go home for the tea after class.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那我两点以前把饭做好。
lines.py: nà wǒ liǎng diǎn yǐ qián bǎ fàn zuò hǎo .
lines.en: I'll have lunch ready before two.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好。希望下午有太阳，吃完还想出去走走。
lines.py: hǎo . xī wàng xià wǔ yǒu tài yáng , chī wán hái xiǎng chū qù zǒu zǒu .
lines.en: Great. I hope it's sunny in the afternoon. I'd still like a walk after eating.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: A plan with two conditions
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 我和陈宇本来想周六去河边，天气预报却说下午有雨。我提议早上去，他上午要上课，不能早点出门。
lines.py: wǒ hé chén yǔ běn lái xiǎng zhōu liù qù hé biān , tiān qì yù bào què shuō xià wǔ yǒu yǔ . wǒ tí yì zǎo shàng qù , tā shàng wǔ yào shàng kè , bù néng zǎo diǎn chū mén .
lines.en: Chen Yu and I had planned a riverside trip on Saturday, but the forecast said afternoon rain. I suggested the morning; he had class and couldn't leave early.

lines.zh: 我们就改成下午在我家见。他两点左右到，带一盒茶，我来做饭。要是没下雨，吃完还可以去河边。
lines.py: wǒ men jiù gǎi chéng xià wǔ zài wǒ jiā jiàn . tā liǎng diǎn zuǒ yòu dào , dài yī hé chá , wǒ lái zuò fàn . yào shì méi xià yǔ , chī wán hái kě yǐ qù hé biān .
lines.en: We switched to meeting at my home in the afternoon. He'd come around two with tea, and I'd cook. If it didn't rain, we could still walk to the river afterwards.

lines.zh: 周六一点半，陈宇发消息，说已经回家拿了茶，预计二十分钟以后到。我把汤放在小火上，等他过来。
lines.py: zhōu liù yī diǎn bàn , chén yǔ fā xiāo xī , shuō yǐ jīng huí jiā ná le chá , yù jì èr shí fēn zhōng yǐ hòu dào . wǒ bǎ tāng fàng zài xiǎo huǒ shàng , děng tā guò lái .
lines.en: At one thirty on Saturday Chen Yu messaged that he'd fetched the tea and expected to arrive twenty minutes later. I left the soup over low heat and waited.

lines.zh: 他进门时，外面刚下起雨。我们先吃饭，聊他今天的课。他说预习时没看懂的一段，老师用一张图讲清楚了。
lines.py: tā jìn mén shí , wài miàn gāng xià qǐ yǔ . wǒ men xiān chī fàn , liáo tā jīn tiān de kè . tā shuō yù xí shí méi kàn dǒng de yī duàn , lǎo shī yòng yī zhāng tú jiǎng qīng chǔ le .
lines.en: It began raining just as he came in. Over lunch we talked about his class. He said the teacher used a diagram to explain a passage he hadn't understood while preparing.

lines.zh: 三点多，雨停了，窗外亮起来。陈宇拿起外套，问我现在还想不想走。我说当然想，碗先放着，回来再洗。
lines.py: sān diǎn duō , yǔ tíng le , chuāng wài liàng qǐ lái . chén yǔ ná qǐ wài tào , wèn wǒ xiàn zài hái xiǎng bù xiǎng zǒu . wǒ shuō dāng rán xiǎng , wǎn xiān fàng zhe , huí lái zài xǐ .
lines.en: After three the rain stopped and it brightened outside. Chen Yu picked up his coat and asked if I still wanted a walk. Of course; we'd leave the dishes and wash them when we returned.

lines.zh: 走到河边，我们发现路上还有不少水。我庆幸今天穿了旧鞋，陈宇却一直低头看他的白鞋，说下次一定穿黑的。
lines.py: zǒu dào hé biān , wǒ men fā xiàn lù shàng hái yǒu bù shǎo shuǐ . wǒ qìng xìng jīn tiān chuān le jiù xié , chén yǔ què yì zhí dī tóu kàn tā de bái xié , shuō xià cì yí dìng chuān hēi de .
lines.en: The riverside path still had puddles. I was glad I'd worn old shoes. Chen Yu kept looking down at his white shoes, saying he'd definitely wear black ones next time.

choices: Lunch indoors, followed by a walk after the rain
questions.answer: Lunch indoors, followed by a walk after the rain

questions.q: Why wish to wear black shoes next time?
choices: The wet path has marked the white ones
Black shoes make tea taste better

lines.zh: 他大概六点到。
lines.py: tā dà gài liù diǎn dào .
lines.en: He'll probably arrive at six.

lines.zh: 我大概读了二十页。
lines.py: wǒ dà gài dú le èr shí yè .
lines.en: I've read roughly twenty pages.

lines.zh: 今天恐怕来不及了。
lines.py: jīn tiān kǒng pà lái bù jí le .
lines.en: I'm afraid we won't have time today.

lines.zh: 恐怕要下雨，带把伞吧。
lines.py: kǒng pà yào xià yǔ , dài bǎ sǎn ba .
lines.en: It looks like rain. Take an umbrella.

lines.zh: 走过去大约十分钟。
lines.py: zǒu guò qù dà yuē shí fēn zhōng .
lines.en: It's about a ten-minute walk.

lines.zh: 房间里大约有十个人。
lines.py: fáng jiān lǐ dà yuē yǒu shí gè rén .
lines.en: There are about ten people in the room.

lines.zh: 我希望明天能见到你。
lines.py: wǒ xī wàng míng tiān néng jiàn dào nǐ .
lines.en: I hope I can see you tomorrow.

lines.zh: 希望这次别再下雨了。
lines.py: xī wàng zhè cì bié zài xià yǔ le .
lines.en: I hope it doesn't rain again this time.

lines.zh: 去海边是她今年的愿望。
lines.py: qù hǎi biān shì tā jīn nián de yuàn wàng .
lines.en: Going to the seaside is her wish for this year.

lines.zh: 生日时你许了什么愿望？
lines.py: shēng rì shí nǐ xǔ le shén me yuàn wàng ?
lines.en: What wish did you make on your birthday?

lines.zh: 将来我想住在海边。
lines.py: jiāng lái wǒ xiǎng zhù zài hǎi biān .
lines.en: I'd like to live by the sea in the future.

lines.zh: 这本书将来可能还会用到。
lines.py: zhè běn shū jiāng lái kě néng hái huì yòng dào .
lines.en: This book might come in useful later.

lines.zh: 我们决定周日出发。
lines.py: wǒ men jué dìng zhōu rì chū fā .
lines.en: We've decided to leave on Sunday.

lines.zh: 你决定点什么菜了吗？
lines.py: nǐ jué dìng diǎn shén me cài le ma ?
lines.en: Have you decided what to order?

lines.zh: 这双鞋很适合走路。
lines.py: zhè shuāng xié hěn shì hé zǒu lù .
lines.en: These shoes are good for walking.

lines.zh: 这个时间不适合打电话。
lines.py: zhè gè shí jiān bù shì hé dǎ diàn huà .
lines.en: This isn't a good time to call.

lines.zh: 你不想去，总有个理由吧。
lines.py: nǐ bù xiǎng qù , zǒng yǒu gè lǐ yóu ba .
lines.en: If you don't want to go, you must have a reason.

lines.zh: 这是我搬家的主要理由。
lines.py: zhè shì wǒ bān jiā de zhǔ yào lǐ yóu .
lines.en: That's my main reason for moving.

lines.zh: 下雨了，我们不得不回家。
lines.py: xià yǔ le , wǒ men bù dé bù huí jiā .
lines.en: It rained, so we had to go home.

lines.zh: 手机没电了，我不得不借他的。
lines.py: shǒu jī méi diàn le , wǒ bù dé bù jiè tā de .
lines.en: My phone ran out of power, so I had to borrow his.

lines.zh: 不必带饭，家里有吃的。
lines.py: bù bì dài fàn , jiā lǐ yǒu chī de .
lines.en: No need to bring food; there's some at home.

lines.zh: 你不必等我，先进去吧。
lines.py: nǐ bù bì děng wǒ , xiān jìn qù ba .
lines.en: You don't need to wait for me. Go in first.

lines.zh: 一直没收到消息，我有点不安。
lines.py: yì zhí méi shōu dào xiāo xī , wǒ yǒu diǎn bù ān .
lines.en: Not hearing anything for so long makes me a little uneasy.

lines.zh: 刚搬来时，她觉得不安。
lines.py: gāng bān lái shí , tā jué de bù ān .
lines.en: She felt uneasy when she first moved here.

lines.zh: 这种投资的风险很高。
lines.py: zhè zhǒng tóu zī de fēng xiǎn hěn gāo .
lines.en: This type of investment is risky.

lines.zh: 我们得先了解可能的风险。
lines.py: wǒ men děi xiān liǎo jiě kě néng de fēng xiǎn .
lines.en: We need to understand the possible risks first.

lines.zh: 早点出门比较保险。
lines.py: zǎo diǎn chū mén bǐ jiào bǎo xiǎn .
lines.en: Leaving early is a safer bet.

lines.zh: 旅行前，我买了保险。
lines.py: lǚ xíng qián , wǒ mǎi le bǎo xiǎn .
lines.en: I bought insurance before travelling.

lines.zh: 见到你，我有点意外。
lines.py: jiàn dào nǐ , wǒ yǒu diǎn yì wài .
lines.en: I'm a little surprised to see you.

lines.zh: 这次旅行出了一个小意外，车坏了。
lines.py: zhè cì lǚ xíng chū le yī gè xiǎo yì wài , chē huài le .
lines.en: There was a small mishap on this trip: the car broke down.

lines.zh: 我们预计八点到家。
lines.py: wǒ men yù jì bā diǎn dào jiā .
lines.en: We expect to get home at eight.

lines.zh: 这项工作预计需要三天。
lines.py: zhè xiàng gōng zuò yù jì xū yào sān tiān .
lines.en: This job is expected to take three days.

lines.zh: 天气预报说下午有雨。
lines.py: tiān qì yù bào shuō xià wǔ yǒu yǔ .
lines.en: The weather forecast says it'll rain this afternoon.

lines.zh: 今晚的天气预报我还没看。
lines.py: jīn wǎn de tiān qì yù bào wǒ hái méi kàn .
lines.en: I haven't seen tonight's weather forecast yet.

lines.zh: 我先预习明天的课。
lines.py: wǒ xiān yù xí míng tiān de kè .
lines.en: I'll prepare for tomorrow's lesson first.

lines.zh: 你预习的时候，看懂这段了吗？
lines.py: nǐ yù xí de shí hou , kàn dǒng zhè duàn le ma ?
lines.en: Did you understand this passage when preparing for class?

lines.zh: 通知上写着原票仍有效。
lines.py: tōng zhī shàng xiě zhe yuán piào réng yǒu xiào .
lines.en: The notice says the original ticket is still valid.

lines.zh: 信中说他仍住在老地方。
lines.py: xìn zhōng shuō tā réng zhù zài lǎo dì fāng .
lines.en: The letter says he still lives at the old address.

lines.zh: 下雨了，他们仍然在等。
lines.py: xià yǔ le , tā men réng rán zài děng .
lines.en: It's raining, but they're still waiting.

lines.zh: 过了十年，我仍然记得那首歌。
lines.py: guò le shí nián , wǒ réng rán jì de nà shǒu gē .
lines.en: Ten years later, I still remember that song.

lines.zh: 我对这个概念还不太清楚。
lines.py: wǒ duì zhè gè gài niàn hái bù tài qīng chǔ .
lines.en: I'm not yet clear about this concept.

lines.zh: 老师用一张图解释这个概念。
lines.py: lǎo shī yòng yī zhāng tú jiě shì zhè gè gài niàn .
lines.en: The teacher explained the concept with a diagram.

lines.zh: 她的生活观念和我不同。
lines.py: tā de shēng huó guān niàn hé wǒ bù tóng .
lines.en: Her outlook on life differs from mine.

lines.zh: 搬到这里以后，我的观念慢慢变了。
lines.py: bān dào zhè lǐ yǐ hòu , wǒ de guān niàn màn màn biàn le .
lines.en: My outlook gradually changed after moving here.

audio.zh: 恐怕不行，我上午要上课。
audio.py: kǒng pà bù xíng , wǒ shàng wǔ yào shàng kè .
audio.en: I'm afraid I can't. I have class in the morning.

notes:
AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 三18, 三69. Native check: 恐怕 pragmatic unwelcome possibility, 大概 versus 大约, adjective 保险 versus insurance noun, 仍 written register, possible versus certain concepts and the friend/plan joke. No claim that forecasts guarantee weather. Native review pending. Planned retrieval 三12 / 三58 / 三15 / 三51: 今天更加清楚，不等于一定更快。, 不比她快，可能一样快。, 通常周末散步，今天只走了二十分钟。, 连续两天不等于坚持了一年。.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Replaced policy-like lines with rainy-day lunch and muddy-shoe teasing, a wrong-date mix-up, student-union registration and travel photos, and a move with tools, a desk and books. All 88 existing vocabulary IDs get two independent contexts; tasks and grammar ownership preserved. Self-review: class rules out morning, lunch around two, walk after three; old cancellation image and current second-floor seven-o’clock show; four classmates, one representative, two-minute talk, host Xiao Zhou; small box tools, large box books, desk assembled below then carried up, narrator goes down and comes back up. False listening statements contradict their own clip. Native flags: 保险 safer versus insurance, written 仍, empathetic 恐怕, rhetorical 难道, student-union 部长/主任 titles, 代表 token sense, 朝 cháo and 背 bēi, directional 上来/上去/下来/下去 tied to speaker position, and teasing personification of dates/books. Native review pending. Native review pending; no independent pronunciation or learner-mastery certification.
